sloka: न चैतदाश्चर्यतमम् यत्तज्ज्येष्ठस्सुतो मम ।अपानृतकथम् पुत्र पितरम् कर्तुमिच्छ्सि ॥२-३४-३८॥
transliteration: na caitadāścaryatamam yattajjyeṣṭhassuto mama ।apānṛtakatham putra pitaram kartumicchsi ॥2-34-38॥

translations.english: It is not a great surprise that you, O my son, being the eldest, want to make your father free from a false promise.
